query:
-- Add TOTP columns to users table (if they don't exist)
ALTER TABLE users
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS totpSecret TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS totpEnabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS totpEnabledAt TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- Create admin_activity_log table if it doesn't exist
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_activity_log (
  id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  actorId INT NOT NULL,
  actorEmail VARCHAR(320) NULL,
  targetUserId INT NULL,
  targetEmail VARCHAR(320) NULL,
  action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  details TEXT NULL,
  totpVerified TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Create service_grants table if it doesn't exist
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_grants (
  id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  grantedBy INT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NULL,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  revokedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  revokedBy INT NULL,
  revokedReason TEXT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
